description: This header defines the LocalInstance class, which represents a local virtual device instance within the Cuttlefish Android emulator project. The class provides methods to access and modify instance properties such as ID, name, state, and directory paths, as well as functions to perform actions like fetching status, restarting, and power washing the instance. It also includes private helpers for internal operations.
